environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a VPC with default networking. Container runs with task role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/app-task-role which has broad permissions. The task is in a private subnet with NAT gateway and can reach the ECS metadata endpoint at 169.254.170.2 and the EC2 IMDS-compatible endpoint at 169.254.169.254. pgBouncer sidecar container handles connection pooling with prepared statement mode. No network ACLs restrict outbound traffic from the container. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group on port 8080.
